correctness.rationale: Replayed all four scripts independently. Analytic identities verified: ||psi||_2=1.253314 (sqrt(pi/2)), C1=2.506628, C3=0.810245, D1=2.828109, S=(2/pi)D1=1.800430>0, independent of (lam,r) because transverse L1 scaling r^{-2}*r^2 cancels and axial |sin| averages to 2/pi. Algebra verified: floor ratio C_osc*a^2/lam^{-1}=C_osc*c_cap*lam^{(1-4al)/3} with (1-4al)/3 in [-1.0,-0.668]<0 on window, so denominator floor-dominated; ratio = a*lam^{-1}*S/(C_osc*a^2+lam^{-1}) ~ a*S = S*sqrt(c_cap)*lam^{-(1+2al)/3} decaying with exponent in [-1.0,-0.834]<0 vs claimed +(4al-3)/3 in (0,+1/3]. FFT gain re-ran: gain*lam in [0.84,0.96] stable over lam=16..256, al in {0.9,1.0}, confirming order-(-1) lam^{-1} gain with O(1) constant. ALL-pairs sweep re-ran: 52/52 violations nominal (worst ratio/bound 4.19e-08 at al=1,k=24), sample lam=4096 al=1 ratio 4.393e-04 vs bound 1.60e-01. Robustness re-ran: 52/52 fail for C_osc in {0,2} x c_cap in {0.1,1,10}; 38-47/52 fail even with 100x numerator inflation, gap widens monotonically in lam so no constant/sub-window repair. Exponent algebra e(al)>0 holds but inequality branch fails, matching binary FAIL condition. Draft honestly delimits scope to standard scaling-model class (Gaussian tube, scalar order-(-1) multiplier, stated oscillation models) and distinguishes proved identities (Sec.2) from machine-checked evidence (Sec.3-4) with extrapolation caveat. Within that delimited headline, computations are correct.

Gain extrapolation: FFT gain verified to two digits over lam=16..256 and extrapolated by scale invariance to lam=2^12..2^24; large-lam transverse frequency lam^{alpha} vs axial lam competition is argued analytically but not FFT-verified in-window due to grid cost.
